criteria.statement: exportCsv filters by exact status and/or region match combined with AND; omitted filters include all records; output rows retain input order.
Output header is exactly id,name,status,region and each row contains only those four fields in that order; internalNotes and any extra record fields never appear in the output.

Cells are comma-delimited; cells containing a comma, double quote, CR, or LF are wrapped in double quotes with embedded quotes doubled; every record (including the header and the last row) ends with CRLF.
When no records match (or the input is empty), exportCsv returns exactly "id,name,status,region\r\n".
exportCsv does not mutate the input records array, any record object, or the filters object.
README.md includes an exportCsv usage example and states that spreadsheet formula injection is not neutralized, so the output is not safe to open as an untrusted spreadsheet.
